questions.question: A suspension cable bridge has a three hinged girder supported by two cables. The roadway is $6\text{ m}$ wide. The girder has its self weight $5\text{ KN/m}^2$. The live load consists of two concentrated loads $200\text{ KN}$ at $20\text{ m}$ from left support and $150\text{ KN}$ at $10\text{ m}$ right from the $200\text{ KN}$ load. The span is $120\text{ m}$ and central dip is $12\text{ m}$. The live loads are acting at the central of the girder. Determine shear force and bending moment at section $25\text{ m}$ from left support of the girder. Also determine required cross sectional area of the cable if the allowable tensile stress of cable material is $120\text{ N/mm}^2$.
